text: たたかい　おわっても　やけどは　のこります　また　やけどなおしで　なおります

structure.jp: たたかい　おわっても
やけどは　のこります
やけどなおしで　なおります
structure.en: it is cured with a Burn Heal

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: A て-verb plus も means 'even if' or 'even when' that happens. たたかい おわっても = 'even when the battle ends'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells you what is used to make it happen. やけどなおしで なおります = 'it gets cured with a Burn Heal'.
